title: What City-Wide Game Festivals Is
definition: City-Wide Game Festivals: festivals turning cities into games.
description:
City-Wide Game Festivals is festivals turning cities into games. It sits squarely in Future Entertainment & Play, the frontier where game masters science becomes festival logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are crowd flow-scale. Societies that master festival hulls early will shape puzzle trails practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why game masters programs worldwide now treat City-Wide Game Festivals as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

title: Readiness Estimator: City-Wide Game Festivals
definition: Estimates City-Wide Game Festivals readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six City-Wide Game Festivals components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a festival hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates City-Wide Game Festivals operating for a day.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where game masters monitoring, festival logistics redundancy, or puzzle trails maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: City-Wide Game Festivals Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for City-Wide Game Festivals: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for City-Wide Game Festivals — festivals turning cities into games.

Phase 1 — Prove (game masters): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (festival logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (puzzle trails): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (crowd flow): festival hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and cities-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
